label: PF Backlog 151
title: Cross-agent traceability hub: index every declared-family id per artifact/stage/agent (+ undeclared findings, coverage, relations)
body: core/traceability.py now owns the hub (single writer of traceability.json -> id_index key, legacy matrix preserved). index_project/refresh_hub/get_hub scan each CANONICAL .md/.txt artifact with the canonical id query (declared families only; single-letter prose noise ignored; derived .html/.xlsx skipped). Records family/stage/agent/artifact/run_id/defined/refs; flags undeclared (invented) prefixes and computes coverage (must/KF<->feature<->requirement<->test). Back-filled existing artifacts (0,0a,0b) -> 106 ids, 0 undeclared. Wired into stage_runner (refresh on stage complete).
